transcript.text: I need to flag a production HSM constraint I discovered this afternoon during a separate access review. The production HSM permits only four key activations per 60-minute period, and the three keys we're rotating cover nine production key slots. I haven't updated the rotation runbook with this vendor limit yet. This could affect our ability to complete all key activations within the reserved Saturday window if the runbook assumes we can activate all nine slots without rate limiting.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a mobile client compatibility issue I discovered this morning while investigating an unrelated mobile authentication ticket. Clients below Android SDK version 8.4 reject the new JWT key identifier, and 17% of active mobile sessions are still on those older clients. The good news is we have a compatibility bridge that can be enabled before rotation, but it requires a seven-day overlap period where both old and new keys are active. I have not yet filed the compatibility note for this. This means the runbook needs to account for enabling the compatibility bridge and maintaining the seven-day overlap before we proceed with the full rotation on Saturday.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: During this week's SOC 2 audit preparation, I confirmed that the production key-rotation control requires two-person approval and a before-and-after key-fingerprint evidence package before the change can be closed. I have not yet added that control detail to the change ticket. This means the runbook needs to include steps for obtaining a second approver and capturing the before-and-after key fingerprints as part of the rotation, otherwise we won't be able to close out this change in a SOC 2-compliant manner.
